preferred_material: Metal alternative: Ponoko #4 brushed 304 stainless, 1.52 mm nominal, brushed on one face. Actual quote offers Linear Deburring for MAIN only; DIV is As cut and needs safe-edge finishing arranged separately. Clear-first is the current recommendation. No exact Kohler BN match.
locator_decision: Select plain upright capsule and a removable four-direction concentric gauge. R006 round-hole/slot tabs were evaluated at 6.4, 7 and 8 mm. Current captured shafts conflict near the seated A tab; current enlarged rod ends also obstruct insertion. Retraction/removal can remove the tip-path conflict but does not establish shaft/formed-plate plane registration. Widening locators adds more stack play than the 1 mm nominal inward gasket reserve. Plain access plus removable centering avoids making those uncertain rod axes an extra constraint.
outer_appearance: Each backing circle concentric with its actual factory cover, constant visible border. Main and diverter border widths need not match each other.

requested_shop_targets.finish: Uniform directional satin grain, same direction on both parts, protect visible face. Confirm final cost and lead time. No exact BN match promised.
